entities.summary: Ivan Mihailov Popov was a Bulgarian communist politician, military officer and statesman. He served in various positions in communist Bulgaria including minister of defence from 1958 to 1962. He was born in the town of Ferdinand on February 22, 1897. His older brother is the famous communist activist Hristo Mihaylov.
